title: A Uniqueness Condition for Conservation Laws with Discontinuous Gradient-Dependent Flux
summary: The paper is concerned with a scalar conservation law with discontinuous gradient-dependent flux. Namely, the flux is described by two different functions $f(u)$ or $g(u)$, when the gradient $u_x$ of the solution is positive or negative, respectively. In the stable case where $f(u)<g(u)$ for all $u\in R$, it was proved in [1] that the limits of vanishing viscosity approximations form a contractive semigroup w.r.t. the $L^1$ distance.
